opportunities.name_zh: 倉敷美觀地區・倉敷川白壁歷史街景
opportunities.best_time: 白天可見光（景點當地時間／JST）
opportunities.best_season: 全年；歷史街景本身不依季節成立

condition_variants.variant_name: 倉敷川・白壁／海鼠壁與柳樹街景
condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"倉敷美観地区・倉敷川 Camera Zone","subject":"preserved white-wall / namako-wall buildings and Kurashiki River streetscape"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: 合法公共街道／河岸步行區；不妨礙居民、店家與行人；不得進入私人建物取景
condition_variants.required_conditions: 白壁、倉敷格子、倉敷川等歷史街景元素清楚可辨；無強降水
condition_variants.boosters: 柔和散射光；柳樹季節感；較少人流
condition_variants.penalties: 強降水；過度人流；越界進入私人範圍

viewpoints.note: Official tourism sources identify the Kurashiki River corridor and preserved white-wall streetscape. Existing high-confidence district anchor is used as an area reference.
viewpoints.name: 倉敷美観地区・倉敷川 Riverside Camera Zone
viewpoints.geometry_note: 倉敷川沿岸公共步行區；可沿河調整白壁、柳樹與橋梁構圖，不宣稱中橋單一腳架位置。

opportunities.name_zh: 倉敷美觀地區・夜間景觀照明與倉敷川倒影
opportunities.best_time: 4–9月日落–22:00；10–3月日落–21:00 的官方標準景觀照明時段（JST）
opportunities.best_season: 全年標準夜間景觀照明；仍以官方當日變更為準

condition_variants.variant_name: 白壁夜間照明・倉敷川水面倒影
condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"倉敷美観地区・倉敷川 Night Reflection Camera Zone","subject":"illuminated white-wall townscape reflected in the Kurashiki River"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: 官方夜間景觀照明實際運作；公共河岸可合法進入；不得把白天低風自動宣稱夜間倒影成立
condition_variants.required_conditions: 白壁／倉敷格子照明與倉敷川水面同框；水面足夠平穩形成可辨識反射；無強降水
condition_variants.boosters: 低風；乾燥；藍調時刻到夜色初段；乾淨水面
condition_variants.penalties: 強風破壞反射；降雨擾動水面；照明取消／臨時變更；人流壅擠

viewpoints.note: Official Kurashiki night-lighting page explicitly documents illuminated white-wall buildings reflected on the river. Anchor is the river corridor, not a single bridge tripod point.
